title: Lift Access Bought Ahead of the Lesson Day at the Snowsports School
content:
Lift access bought ahead of the day costs less than lift access bought at the window. The distance is counted in calendar days between the handling date and the date the session is due to run, the handling date counting as day zero.

Where the session is seven or more days off, the advance ticket points are allowed, and they stand at 15 points. Where the session is between one and six days off, the near ticket points are allowed, and they stand at 5 points. Where the session falls on the handling date or has already passed, the window ticket points are allowed, and they stand at 0 points.

## Schedule of points by distance from the session

| Calendar days between the handling date and the session date | Points allowed |
| --- | --- |
| 7 or more | 15 |
| exactly 7 | 15 |
| 6 | 5 |
| 1 | 5 |
| none, the session falling on the handling date | 0 |
| the session already passed | 0 |

## Both sides of each boundary

Take a handling date of the tenth of a month. Counting the tenth as day zero, a session due on the seventeenth is 7 days off and falls in the first band; a session due on the sixteenth is 6 days off and falls in the second; a session due on the eleventh is 1 day off and falls in the second; a session due on the tenth itself is none days off and falls in the third, as does one due on the ninth.

## What the points do

The points are a reduction in percentage points on the lift access add-on for a Snowsports School booking. They are combined with the other reductions allowed on that add-on into one total in percentage points, and the add-on figure is reduced once by that total rather than by each reduction in turn. On an add-on figure of 300.00 USD, 15 points take off 45.00 USD and 5 points take off 15.00 USD.
